text: こうげきは　たかいが　はずれやすい

structure.jp: こうげきは　たかいが

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい on a verb stem means the thing happens easily or often. はずれやすい = 'misses easily'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of one part of a sentence means 'but'. こうげきは　たかいが = 'Attack is high, but'.
